objective: Select about 100 distinct, commerce-capable product pages from a larger evidence-qualified research pool without repeating existing search intent.

publicationPolicy.releaseRule: Do not add a page to sitemap, home, category discovery, or IndexNow until its exact-product, evidence, image, merchant, collision, and reciprocal-link gates pass.

requiredGates: Distinct query and purchase decision with no stronger existing canonical page
Current product demand and a live SERP opening
Opportunity score of at least 70 out of 100
Exact current model, ASIN or authorized CJ item and variant
Current merchant link, availability signal, seller or direct-brand path, and return terms
Official manufacturer or authoritative primary source plus a second decision source
Original realistic local bitmap image and accurate alt text
Official-spec or research-synthesis evidence mode with no invented hands-on claims
First-viewport commerce path and full-width sticky commerce target where eligible
At least four contextual internal links with reciprocal discovery after release
No title, URL, family, or decision-intent collision with the existing portfolio
Local SEO, affiliate-link, conversion-path, and production-render checks
releaseBlockers: The August 2026 spam-update recovery freeze blocks new indexable expansion across all seven affiliate sites until rollout completion, three complete Search Console days, and the applicable exact cohort gate.
The prior 194-family research pool is exhausted: 151 released, 34 excluded, and 9 failed exact-product checks.
The remaining 125 candidates must still be researched before about 100 pages can be selected honestly; five products have passed the first soft-launch gate.
No unverified ASIN, merchant link, generated claim, or duplicate intent may be converted into a public page to fill the target count.
